titulo: Lessons and rules: batch approval and review of an expired rule
lead: The other side of the loop that learns is not a number: it is the lesson the agent draws from a mistake. Written straight into CLAUDE.md, it only grows, and nobody decides on it or reviews it. In this lesson you use SIL Loop R: occurrence, proposal, batch approval with an explicit decision, and automatic review when the rule's file changes.
objetivo: record an occurrence and a proposal in SIL Loop R, approve in batch with an explicit decision, and reopen the rule when the watched file changes.

aprende.t: Occurrence, proposal and rule: three different things
Approval batch: the agent proposes, the person decides
Rule on trial with a date and a criterion
Review by changed file, age and lack of use

hero_alt: Open metal card file with cards organized by dividers and one pulled-out card with a yellow border.

secoes.titulo: The path of a lesson in SIL Loop R
secoes.sub: sil.py 1.1.0, local SQLite in the project's .sil folder. No command sends a message or calls a model. Click each block.

nos.detalhe: What happened, with evidence, probable cause and correction. occurrence --title --evidence --cause --correction. Observed fact, hypothesis about the cause and proven correction go in separate fields.
The generalizable rule, with scope and, if you want, watched files: lesson --occurrence O0001 --proposal --scope --watch serve.sh. It starts as proposed.
status says approval_due when the batch arrives (by number of proposals, days or releases). request prepares the batch to show to the person in the same turn.
decide ID adopt|trial|defer|reject --approved-by --reason. Trial and defer require a future date; trial requires a criterion. The agent does not invent the approver. Silence is never approval.
Once adopted, the proposal becomes a rule (R0001) and shows up in context. It is not in the instruction file yet: that is lesson 5.

The rule goes back to review when a watched file changes (SHA-256), when it passes review_days (30) or after 5 releases without being cited. review ID keep|revise|retire, again with an explicit decision.

secoes.volta: a review can keep, rewrite or retire the rule

secoes.sub: Rehearsal project in /tmp. The j only prints the JSON fields that sil.py returns.

blocos.conteudo:
SIL=~/projetos/sil-loop-r/sil.py   # git clone https://github.com/inematds/sil-loop-r ~/projetos/sil-loop-r
E=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ensaio-aprende/a4; rm -rf $E; mkdir -p $E/p; cd $E/p && git init -q
echo 'python3 -m http.server 8000' > serve.sh
s() { python3 $SIL --project $E/p "$@"; }
j() { python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(*[k+"="+json.dumps(d.get(k),ensure_ascii=False) for k in sys.argv[1:]])' "$@"; }
s init | j version; s config --approval-batch 2 | j approval_batch
s occurrence --title "porta ocupada" --evidence "teste HTTP falhou: address already in use" \
  --cause "servidor de outra sessão na mesma porta" --correction "checar a porta antes" | j id
s lesson --occurrence O0001 --proposal "checar a porta antes de subir servidor" --scope "testes HTTP" --watch serve.sh | j id status
s occurrence --title "push no remoto errado" --evidence "git push foi para origin, não para o remoto da conta" | j id
s lesson --occurrence O0002 --proposal "conferir git remote -v antes do push" --scope "publicação" | j id status
echo "## fim da tarefa: chegou a hora do lote?"; s status | j approval_due approval_reasons
s request | j requested

abas.html:
version="1.1.0"
approval_batch=2
id="O0001"
id="L0001" status="proposed"
id="O0002"
id="L0002" status="proposed"
## fim da tarefa: chegou a hora do lote?
approval_due=true approval_reasons=["lote de novas propostas"]
requested=true

With the batch set to 2, the second proposal turns on approval_due. From here on, the agent shows the person the ID, proposal, evidence, scope and suggested decision, and waits.

secoes.titulo: Decide, and watch the rule go back to review
secoes.sub: Continues the previous block. One proposal adopted, another on trial for 14 days; then the watched file changes.

blocos.conteudo:
SIL=~/projetos/sil-loop-r/sil.py
E=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ensaio-aprende/a4; cd $E/p   # continua o bloco anterior
s() { python3 $SIL --project $E/p "$@"; }
j() { python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(*[k+"="+json.dumps(d.get(k),ensure_ascii=False) for k in sys.argv[1:]])' "$@"; }
ATE=$(python3 -c 'import datetime; print(datetime.date.today() + datetime.timedelta(days=14))')
s decide L0001 adopt --approved-by "Seu Nome" --reason "falhou duas vezes; correção comprovada" | j status rule
s decide L0002 trial --until $ATE --criterion "nenhum push no remoto errado em 14 dias" \
  --approved-by "Seu Nome" --reason "uma ocorrência só" | j status
s check > /dev/null; echo "check: $?"
echo "## o arquivo vigiado mudou"; echo 'python3 -m http.server 8080' > serve.sh
s check | j reviews; s check > /dev/null; echo "check: $?"
s review R0001 keep --approved-by "Seu Nome" --reason "a porta mudou; a regra continua valendo" | j status
s check > /dev/null; echo "check: $?"

abas.html:
status="adopted" rule="R0001"
status="trial"
check: 0
## o arquivo vigiado mudou
reviews=[{"id": "R0001", "reasons": ["arquivo alterado: serve.sh"]}]
check: 1
status="active"
check: 0

check exits 0 with nothing pending, 1 with something pending (here, the review) and 2 on error. Exit 0 does not prove the rules are true; only that nothing is overdue.

Trial with a past date: decide L0002 trial --until 2026-10-01 answers {"error": "Teste e adiamento exigem data futura."} (captured on 10/19/2026). That is why the block calculates the date with Python.

secoes.titulo: Real case: this machine's lesson loop
secoes.sub: INEMA uses LESSONS.md, FALHAS.md and LIMITES.md in the wifi project (the monitoring hub). Counts only; no line from the files appears here.

texto: The sil-melhoramento/ANALISE.md analysis counted 37 lessons in wifi's CLAUDE.md, 101 lines in FALHAS.md and 255 in LIMITES.md, 49 still "aberto".
Its conclusion: 100% "prose" rung, no triage, no ID, no citation and no pruning. The lesson about a busy port had been written three times on different dates.
contar-licoes.py, run in the wifi folder: 164 lessons in LESSONS.md (9 marked as repeated, none with an ID), 167 failures and 424 limits, 115 still "aberto".
In 14 days the open ones more than doubled. That is what happens when a lesson comes in without a decision and without a review date.
Of the analysis recommendations, only the SIL promotion was done (v1.1.0, 10/05). The others (gates hook, clock in LIMITES, IDs on lessons, post-translation probe) remain proposals.
SIL has not been started in wifi yet: the case serves as a diagnosis, not a showcase.

secoes.sub: Run it in your project folder. The script only counts lines and marks; it does not print content.

blocos.conteudo:
K=~/projetos/loop-r-eng-aprende-v72/kit
cd ~/projetos/<seu-projeto>   # a pasta onde ficam o seu CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md e as suas lições
python3 $K/contar-licoes.py .

abas.html:
CLAUDE.md: 82 linhas, 19 lições na seção Lessons
AGENTS.md: 10 linhas, 0 lições na seção Lessons
LESSONS.md: 164 lições · 9 marcadas como repetidas · 0 com ID
FALHAS.md: 167 falhas · 90 prompt · 85 infra (as duas contam quando a linha diz as duas)
LIMITES.md: 424 limites · 115 ainda 'aberto'
SIL Loop R: não iniciado nesta pasta
degrau: prosa — sem decisão registrada, sem data de revisão, sem citação

The prompt and infra columns add up to more than the total because 8 lines say both.

exercicios.titulo: E10 · The batch in the rehearsal
exercicios.pronto: the first shows approval_due=true and requested=true; the second ends with check: 0, check: 1 (after changing serve.sh) and check: 0.

exercicios.titulo: E11 · Diagnosis of your lessons loop
exercicios.texto: Run contar-licoes.py in your project and note how many lessons exist, how many are repeated, and whether any has an ID or review date.
exercicios.pronto: python3 $K/contar-licoes.py . prints the SIL Loop R: line and at least one count line.

exercicios.titulo: E12 · Three real lessons in the SIL
exercicios.texto: Start the SIL in your project, take the three lessons that repeat the most, and record each one as occurrence + proposal, with --watch on the file the rule protects. When the batch kicks in, decide yourself, with a reason.
exercicios.pronto: python3 $SIL --project . export | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(len(json.load(sys.stdin)["rules"]))' → at least 1, and python3 $SIL --project . check; echo $? → 0.

perguntas.p: The approval batch arrived and the person did not respond. What does the agent do?
opcoes: Adopts everything, because the deadline passed
Decides nothing: silence is not approval
perguntas.explica: The deadline controls when to ask for a decision; it does not authorize. Nothing is executed until there is an explicit decision for the IDs presented.

perguntas.p: Which of these sends an active rule back to review in the SIL?
opcoes: The agent disagreed with the rule
perguntas.explica: The SIL stores the SHA-256 of the watched files; if it changed, the rule goes into reviews. It also reviews by age and by releases without citation.

perguntas.p: What does a trial require that adoption does not?
opcoes: A future date and a success criterion
perguntas.explica: trial requires --until with a future date and --criterion. Without a criterion, a trial becomes a rule out of fatigue.

perguntas.p: The check exited with 0. What does that guarantee?
opcoes: That all the rules are still true and were followed by the agent in the last session
That the agent followed the rules
That there is no overdue decision, flagged review, or outdated promotion
perguntas.explica: The skill itself warns: exit 0 does not prove the rules are true. It only says there is nothing pending.

perguntas.p: In the wifi case, what shows that a lesson in prose alone does not close the loop?
opcoes: Open limits more than doubled in 14 days, with no decision date
The LESSONS.md is small and almost all the lessons have already been turned into hooks
perguntas.explica: From 49 to 115 open between 10/05 and 10/19. Without a dated decision and review, the list only grows.

itens.texto: An occurrence is the fact, a proposal is the lesson, a rule is the approved lesson; each one with an ID.
The agent proposes and prepares the batch; the person decides with a name and a reason; silence does not approve.
A changed file, age, or lack of use reopens the rule; check tells you when something is pending.
